title: Arithmetic Progression (AP)
description: Print an arithmetic progression and compute its sum.
formula: a, a+d, a+2d, ... (n terms);  Sum = n/2 × [2a + (n−1)d]
code:
terms=[]
for i in range(n):
    terms.append(a + i*d)
print('Terms:', *terms)
print('Sum:', sum(terms))

title: Geometric Progression (GP)
description: Print a geometric progression and compute its sum.
formula: a, ar, ar², ... (n terms);  Sum = a(r^n − 1)/(r − 1) (r≠1)
code:
terms=[]
val=a
for _ in range(n):
    terms.append(val)
    val*=r
print('Terms:', *terms)
print('Sum:', sum(terms))

title: Harmonic Series (1 + 1/2 + ... + 1/n)
description: Print the harmonic series (as decimals) and compute its sum.
code:
terms=[]
for i in range(1, n+1):
    terms.append(1/i)
print('Terms:')
for i,t in enumerate(terms,1):
    print(f'1/{i} = {t:.{precision}f}')
print('Sum:', round(sum(terms), precision))

title: Sum of Squares (1² + 2² + ... + n²)
description: Print squares and compute the sum of squares.
code:
terms=[i*i for i in range(1, n+1)]
print('Squares:', *terms)
print('Sum:', sum(terms))
print('Formula:', n*(n+1)*(2*n+1)//6)

title: Fibonacci Series + Summation
description: Print first n Fibonacci numbers and compute their sum.
code:
a,b=0,1
terms=[]
for _ in range(n):
    terms.append(a)
    a,b=b,a+b
print('Terms:', *terms)
print('Sum:', sum(terms))

title: Alternating Series (1 - 2 + 3 - 4 + ... ± n)
description: Print alternating signed integers and compute the sum.
code:
terms=[]
for i in range(1, n+1):
    terms.append(i if i%2==1 else -i)
print('Terms:', *terms)
print('Sum:', sum(terms))
